system.description:
• Effect: Choose one element — fire, cold, lightning, earth, water, or air. The Druid is immune to its damage entirely.
  • When struck by a spell of that element, make a Wisdom check against the spell's save DC
  • Succeed on the check: the spell is reflected back at a target of the Druid's choice for its original damage

activities.name: Reflect Spell
activities.text: When struck by a spell of your chosen element, beat its save DC to reflect it at a target of your choice.

options.name: Earth
options.text: Immune to damage from earth (the GM says which damage that covers).

rules.value: Elemental Mastery (Earth): immune to earth damage (the GM's call which damage that is).

options.name: Water
options.text: Immune to damage from water (the GM says which damage that covers).

rules.value: Elemental Mastery (Water): immune to water damage (the GM's call which damage that is).

options.name: Air
options.text: Immune to damage from air (the GM says which damage that covers).

rules.value: Elemental Mastery (Air): immune to air damage (the GM's call which damage that is).
